questions.text: Is there a cycling infrastructure on this street?

options.text: Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with other road users

questions.text: Is the cycling infrastructure one-way or two-way?
Which other road users commonly use or enter the cycling facility? (Select all that apply)
How is the cycling infrastructure separated from other road users? [Select all that apply]

options.text: Marked bike lane on the road (painted/road markings only)
Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs, or planters
Separate space from pedestrians, but at the same level
Physically separated from pedestrians (different level, kerb etc.)

questions.text: What type of surface does the cycling infrastructure have?
Are there any problems affecting cycling comfort? (Select all that apply)
How often do you encounter surface problems?
Are there any obstacles making cycling difficult? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Vehicles stopping in the cycle lane
E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parked on the facility
Trees, poles, signs, or utility boxes
Public transport stop/people waiting for public transport

questions.text: How often do obstacles block or reduce the cycling space?
Does the cycling facility have conflict points with vehicle access? (Examples: driveways, property entrances, side streets, car park entrances/exits, loading areas)
Would you like to have a cycling infrastructure along this link?

it.#Is there a cycling infrastructure on th: Su questa strada è presente un'infrastruttura ciclabile?
it.#Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with: Sì, infrastruttura ciclabile condivisa con altri utenti della strada
it.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: L'infrastruttura ciclabile è a senso unico o a doppio senso?
it.#Which other road users commonly use or: Quali altri utenti della strada usano o entrano spesso nell'infrastruttura ciclabile? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni pertinenti)
it.#How is the cycling infrastructure separ: Come è separata l'infrastruttura ciclabile dagli altri utenti della strada? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni pertinenti)
it.#Marked bike lane on the road (painted/r: Corsia ciclabile segnata sulla strada (solo vernice/segnaletica orizzontale)
it.#Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs,: Separata da paletti, barriere, cordoli o fioriere
it.#Separate space from pedestrians, but at: Spazio separato dai pedoni, ma allo stesso livello
it.#Physically separated from pedestrians (: Fisicamente separata dai pedoni (livello diverso, cordolo, ecc.)
it.#What type of surface does the cycling i: Che tipo di superficie ha l'infrastruttura ciclabile?
it.#Are there any problems affecting cyclin: Ci sono problemi che riducono il comfort in bicicletta? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni pertinenti)
it.#Surface vibration is uncomfortable: Le vibrazioni della superficie sono fastidiose
it.#How often do you encounter surface prob: Con quale frequenza incontri problemi della superficie?
it.#Are there any obstacles making cycling: Ci sono ostacoli che rendono difficile andare in bicicletta? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni pertinenti)
it.#E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parke: Monopattini, biciclette o moto parcheggiati sull'infrastruttura ciclabile
it.#Trees, poles, signs, or utility boxes: Alberi, pali, segnali o cassette tecniche
it.#Outdoor café or restaurant seating: Tavoli o sedute esterne di bar e ristoranti
it.#Shop displays or street vendors: Espositori dei negozi o venditori ambulanti
it.#Public transport stop/people waiting fo: Fermata del trasporto pubblico/persone in attesa
it.#How often do obstacles block or reduce: Con quale frequenza gli ostacoli bloccano o restringono lo spazio ciclabile?
it.#Does the cycling facility have conflict: L'infrastruttura ciclabile ha punti di conflitto con accessi veicolari? (Ad es. passi carrabili, ingressi a proprietà, strade laterali, ingressi/uscite di parcheggi, aree di carico)
it.#Would you like to have a cycling infras: Vorresti un'infrastruttura ciclabile lungo questo tratto?

fr.#Is there a cycling infrastructure on th: Y a-t-il un aménagement cyclable dans cette rue ?
fr.#Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with: Oui, aménagement cyclable partagé avec d'autres usagers
fr.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: L'aménagement cyclable est-il à sens unique ou à double sens ?
fr.#Which other road users commonly use or: Quels autres usagers utilisent ou pénètrent souvent dans l'aménagement cyclable ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses pertinentes)
fr.#How is the cycling infrastructure separ: Comment l'aménagement cyclable est-il séparé des autres usagers ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses pertinentes)
fr.#Marked bike lane on the road (painted/r: Bande cyclable marquée sur la chaussée (peinture/marquage uniquement)
fr.#Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs,: Séparé par des potelets, barrières, bordures ou jardinières
fr.#Separate space from pedestrians, but at: Espace séparé des piétons, mais au même niveau
fr.#Physically separated from pedestrians (: Physiquement séparé des piétons (niveau différent, bordure, etc.)
fr.#What type of surface does the cycling i: Quel type de revêtement a l'aménagement cyclable ?
fr.#Are there any problems affecting cyclin: Y a-t-il des problèmes qui réduisent le confort à vélo ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses pertinentes)
fr.#Surface vibration is uncomfortable: Les vibrations du revêtement sont inconfortables
fr.#How often do you encounter surface prob: À quelle fréquence rencontrez-vous des problèmes de revêtement ?
fr.#Are there any obstacles making cycling: Y a-t-il des obstacles qui rendent la pratique du vélo difficile ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses pertinentes)
fr.#Vehicles stopping in the cycle lane: Véhicules arrêtés sur la piste/bande cyclable
fr.#E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parke: Trottinettes, vélos ou motos stationnés sur l'aménagement cyclable
fr.#Trees, poles, signs, or utility boxes: Arbres, poteaux, panneaux ou boîtiers techniques
fr.#Outdoor café or restaurant seating: Terrasses de cafés ou de restaurants
fr.#Shop displays or street vendors: Étalages de magasins ou vendeurs ambulants
fr.#Public transport stop/people waiting fo: Arrêt de transport public/personnes en attente
fr.#How often do obstacles block or reduce: À quelle fréquence les obstacles bloquent-ils ou réduisent-ils l'espace cyclable ?
fr.#Does the cycling facility have conflict: L'aménagement cyclable croise-t-il des accès de véhicules ? (Ex. entrées privées, rues latérales, entrées/sorties de parkings, zones de livraison)
fr.#Would you like to have a cycling infras: Souhaiteriez-vous un aménagement cyclable le long de ce tronçon ?

de.#Is there a cycling infrastructure on th: Gibt es auf dieser Straße Radinfrastruktur?
de.#Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with: Ja, Radinfrastruktur gemeinsam mit anderen Verkehrsteilnehmern
de.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: Ist die Radinfrastruktur ein- oder zweirichtungsgeführt?
de.#Which other road users commonly use or: Welche anderen Verkehrsteilnehmer nutzen oder betreten die Radinfrastruktur häufig? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#How is the cycling infrastructure separ: Wie ist die Radinfrastruktur von anderen Verkehrsteilnehmern getrennt? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#Marked bike lane on the road (painted/r: Markierter Radfahrstreifen auf der Fahrbahn (nur Farbe/Markierung)
de.#Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs,: Durch Poller, Barrieren, Bordsteine oder Pflanzkübel getrennt
de.#Separate space from pedestrians, but at: Von Fußgängern getrennter Bereich auf gleicher Höhe
de.#Physically separated from pedestrians (: Physisch von Fußgängern getrennt (anderes Niveau, Bordstein usw.)
de.#Are there any problems affecting cyclin: Gibt es Probleme, die den Fahrkomfort beim Radfahren beeinträchtigen? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#Are there any obstacles making cycling: Gibt es Hindernisse, die das Radfahren erschweren? (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)
de.#E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parke: E-Scooter, Fahrräder oder Motorräder auf der Radinfrastruktur geparkt
de.#How often do obstacles block or reduce: Wie häufig blockieren oder verengen Hindernisse den Radverkehrsraum?
de.#Does the cycling facility have conflict: Gibt es Konfliktpunkte mit Fahrzeugzufahrten? (z. B. Einfahrten, Grundstückszugänge, Seitenstraßen, Parkplatzein-/ausfahrten, Ladezonen)
de.#Would you like to have a cycling infras: Wünschen Sie sich auf diesem Abschnitt Radinfrastruktur?

tr.#Is there a cycling infrastructure on th: Bu sokakta bisiklet altyapısı var mı?
tr.#Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with: Evet, diğer yol kullanıcılarıyla paylaşılan bisiklet altyapısı
tr.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: Bisiklet altyapısı tek yönlü mü, çift yönlü mü?
tr.#Which other road users commonly use or: Bisiklet alanını başka hangi yol kullanıcıları sık kullanıyor veya giriyor? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#How is the cycling infrastructure separ: Bisiklet altyapısı diğer yol kullanıcılarından nasıl ayrılıyor? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Marked bike lane on the road (painted/r: Yolda işaretli bisiklet şeridi (yalnızca boya/yol çizgisi)
tr.#Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs,: Dubalar, bariyerler, bordürler veya saksılarla ayrılmış
tr.#Separate space from pedestrians, but at: Yayalardan ayrılmış, ancak aynı seviyede alan
tr.#Physically separated from pedestrians (: Yayalardan fiziksel olarak ayrılmış (farklı seviye, bordür vb.)
tr.#Are there any problems affecting cyclin: Bisiklet sürüş konforunu azaltan sorunlar var mı? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Are there any obstacles making cycling: Bisiklet sürmeyi zorlaştıran engeller var mı? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parke: Bisiklet alanına park edilmiş e-scooter, bisiklet veya motosikletler
tr.#Trees, poles, signs, or utility boxes: Ağaçlar, direkler, işaretler veya elektrik kutuları
tr.#Outdoor café or restaurant seating: Kafe veya restoranların dış oturma alanları
tr.#How often do obstacles block or reduce: Engeller bisiklet alanını ne sıklıkla kapatıyor veya daraltıyor?
tr.#Does the cycling facility have conflict: Bisiklet altyapısında araç girişleriyle çatışma noktaları var mı? (Örn. garaj girişleri, mülk girişleri, yan yollar, otopark giriş/çıkışları, yükleme alanları)
tr.#Would you like to have a cycling infras: Bu yol kesimi boyunca bisiklet altyapısı olmasını ister misiniz?

fa.#Is there a cycling infrastructure on th: آیا در این خیابان زیرساخت دوچرخه وجود دارد؟
fa.#Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with: بله، زیرساخت دوچرخه با سایر کاربران مسیر مشترک است
fa.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: مسیر دوچرخه یک‌طرفه است یا دوطرفه؟
fa.#Which other road users commonly use or: کدام کاربران دیگر مسیر معمولاً وارد فضای دوچرخه می‌شوند یا از آن استفاده می‌کنند؟ (همه موارد مرتبط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#How is the cycling infrastructure separ: زیرساخت دوچرخه چگونه از سایر کاربران مسیر جدا شده است؟ (همه موارد مرتبط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Marked bike lane on the road (painted/r: خط دوچرخه مشخص‌شده روی خیابان (فقط رنگ یا خط‌کشی)
fa.#Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs,: با بولارد، مانع، جدول یا گلدان جدا شده است
fa.#Separated by parked cars: با خودروهای پارک‌شده جدا شده است
fa.#Separate space from pedestrians, but at: فضای جدا از عابران پیاده، اما در همان سطح
fa.#Physically separated from pedestrians (: از نظر فیزیکی از عابران پیاده جدا شده است (اختلاف سطح، جدول و غیره)
fa.#What type of surface does the cycling i: سطح مسیر دوچرخه از چه نوعی است؟
fa.#Are there any problems affecting cyclin: آیا مشکلاتی وجود دارد که راحتی دوچرخه‌سواری را کاهش دهد؟ (همه موارد مرتبط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#How often do you encounter surface prob: مشکلات سطح را چند وقت یک‌بار می‌بینید؟
fa.#Are there any obstacles making cycling: آیا موانعی وجود دارد که دوچرخه‌سواری را دشوار کند؟ (همه موارد مرتبط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parke: اسکوتر برقی، دوچرخه یا موتورسیکلت پارک‌شده در مسیر دوچرخه
fa.#Trees, poles, signs, or utility boxes: درختان، تیرها، تابلوها یا جعبه‌های تأسیسات
fa.#Outdoor café or restaurant seating: میز و صندلی بیرونی کافه یا رستوران
fa.#How often do obstacles block or reduce: موانع چند وقت یک‌بار فضای دوچرخه را مسدود یا محدود می‌کنند؟
fa.#Does the cycling facility have conflict: آیا مسیر دوچرخه با ورودی و خروجی خودروها تداخل دارد؟ (مثلاً ورودی ملک، خیابان فرعی، ورودی/خروجی پارکینگ، محل بارگیری)
fa.#Would you like to have a cycling infras: آیا مایلید در این بخش مسیر زیرساخت دوچرخه ایجاد شود؟

hu.#Is there a cycling infrastructure on th: Van kerékpáros infrastruktúra ezen az utcán?
hu.#Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with: Igen, más közlekedőkkel közös kerékpáros infrastruktúra
hu.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: A kerékpáros infrastruktúra egy- vagy kétirányú?
hu.#Which other road users commonly use or: Milyen más közlekedők használják vagy foglalják el gyakran a kerékpáros infrastruktúrát? (Több válasz is jelölhető)
hu.#How is the cycling infrastructure separ: Hogyan van elválasztva a kerékpáros infrastruktúra a többi közlekedőtől? (Több válasz is jelölhető)
hu.#Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs,: Oszlopokkal, korláttal, szegéllyel vagy növényládákkal elválasztva
hu.#Separate space from pedestrians, but at: A gyalogosoktól elkülönített, de azonos szintű terület
hu.#Physically separated from pedestrians (: Fizikailag elkülönítve a gyalogosoktól (más szint, szegély stb.)
hu.#What type of surface does the cycling i: Milyen burkolata van a kerékpáros infrastruktúrának?
hu.#Are there any problems affecting cyclin: Vannak a kerékpározás kényelmét rontó problémák? (Több válasz is jelölhető)
hu.#Are there any obstacles making cycling: Vannak akadályok, amelyek megnehezítik a kerékpározást? (Több válasz is jelölhető)
hu.#E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parke: A kerékpáros infrastruktúrán parkoló rollerek, kerékpárok vagy motorok
hu.#How often do obstacles block or reduce: Milyen gyakran akadályozzák vagy szűkítik az akadályok a kerékpáros teret?
hu.#Does the cycling facility have conflict: Vannak ütközési pontok a járműbehajtókkal? (pl. kapubejárók, ingatlanbejáratok, mellékutcák, parkolóbejáratok/-kijáratok, rakodóhelyek)
hu.#Would you like to have a cycling infras: Szeretne kerékpáros infrastruktúrát ezen az útszakaszon?

ar.#Is there a cycling infrastructure on th: هل توجد بنية تحتية للدراجات في هذا الشارع؟
ar.#Yes, cycling infrastructure shared with: نعم، بنية تحتية للدراجات مشتركة مع مستخدمي الطريق الآخرين
ar.#Is the cycling infrastructure one-way o: هل مسار الدراجات باتجاه واحد أم باتجاهين؟
ar.#Which other road users commonly use or: ما مستخدمو الطريق الآخرون الذين يستخدمون أو يدخلون مسار الدراجات عادةً؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#How is the cycling infrastructure separ: كيف يتم فصل مسار الدراجات عن مستخدمي الطريق الآخرين؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#Marked bike lane on the road (painted/r: مسار دراجات محدد على الطريق (دهان/علامات أرضية فقط)
ar.#Separated by bollards, barriers, kerbs,: مفصول بحواجز أو أعمدة أو أرصفة أو أحواض نباتات
ar.#Separate space from pedestrians, but at: مساحة منفصلة عن المشاة ولكن على المستوى نفسه
ar.#Physically separated from pedestrians (: مفصول ماديًا عن المشاة (مستوى مختلف، رصيف، إلخ)
ar.#Are there any problems affecting cyclin: هل توجد مشكلات تؤثر في راحة ركوب الدراجة؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#How often do you encounter surface prob: كم مرة تواجه مشكلات في السطح؟
ar.#Are there any obstacles making cycling: هل توجد عوائق تجعل ركوب الدراجة صعبًا؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#E-scooters, Bicycles, motorcycles parke: دراجات أو سكوترات كهربائية أو نارية متوقفة في مسار الدراجات
ar.#Trees, poles, signs, or utility boxes: أشجار أو أعمدة أو لافتات أو صناديق خدمات
ar.#How often do obstacles block or reduce: كم مرة تعيق العوائق أو تقلل مساحة الدراجات؟
ar.#Does the cycling facility have conflict: هل توجد نقاط تعارض بين مسار الدراجات ومداخل المركبات؟ (مثل مداخل العقارات والشوارع الجانبية ومداخل/مخارج مواقف السيارات ومناطق التحميل)
ar.#Would you like to have a cycling infras: هل ترغب في وجود بنية تحتية للدراجات على هذا المقطع؟
